summary: pipe_copy_hosttest.c with six faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/ipc/pipe.c

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc tests/host/pipe_copy_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/pipe_copy_hosttest

faults.name: read
faults.summary: a read that does not fault the user's pages in before it copies

faults.name: write
faults.summary: a write that does not fault the user's pages in before it copies

faults.name: read-kind
faults.summary: a read that wakes the writers for every kind of change, not room alone

lines: a read wakes the writers for room alone

faults.name: write-kind
faults.summary: a write that wakes the readers for every kind of change, not data alone

lines: a write wakes the readers for data alone

faults.name: close-kind
faults.summary: a close that wakes the readers for data, not for a hangup

lines: a close wakes the readers for a hangup

faults.name: write-empty-only
faults.summary: a write that wakes the readers only when the ring was empty

lines: a write into a ring that has data wakes the readers for data
